therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with metastatic colorectal cancer receiving FOLFOXIRI/bevacizumab
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Duration of Severe Neutropenia and Occurrence of Severe Neutropenia

results.effect_size: DSN: Mean difference -1.2 days (95% CI: -1.7 to -0.6); SN occurrence: aRR 0.04 (95% CI: 0.01-0.19)
safety_signals: Higher rate of AE leading to death (8 vs 3)
Cardiac events including acute MI and cardiac failure
results.dose_information: IV infusion over 30 minutes, administered no more than 4 hours prior to chemotherapy on Day 1, with second dose on Day 2

context.duration: up to 12 cycles (24 weeks) induction period, follow-up to 52 months
